--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,27 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+> **Note:** this project does not have a test suite yet. The commands below describe the intended setup; running them today collects zero tests and pytest exits with code 5 (`no tests ran`).
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/). Install it into your environment:
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+```
+
+Then run the full suite from the repository root:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest
+```
+
+Useful variations:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py   # a single file
+python3 -m pytest -k reconcile            # tests whose name matches an expression
+python3 -m pytest -v                      # one line per test instead of a progress dot
+```
+
+New tests go in files named `test_*.py` at the repository root, alongside the module they cover, with test functions named `test_*` — that is pytest's default discovery convention, so no configuration file is required.
